definitions.explanation: Snow falling from the sky, or the amount of snow that has fallen. A formal term used in weather reports, news, and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{降雪|こうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Snowfall has continued since last night.

examples.japanese: {降雪|こうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Trains are delayed due to snowfall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{降雪量|こうせつりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二倍|にばい}→二倍：01485_nibai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are areas where snowfall this year has exceeded double the usual amount.

notes:
Compound of {降|こう} (to fall/descend) + {雪|せつ} (snow). A formal, written term commonly seen in weather forecasts and news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降雪量|こうせつりょう} (amount of snowfall)
- {降雪|こうせつ}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (snowfall area)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{降雪|こうせつ} (heavy snowfall)
- {降雪|こうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ (effects of snowfall)

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, people say ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (it snows) rather than using {降雪|こうせつ}. {降雪|こうせつ} belongs to the formal register of weather terminology, similar to ⟦{降水|こうすい}→降水：09807_kousui⟧ (precipitation).
